question: M1 Max在Apple Silicon优化框架（MLX/llama.cpp）下运行7B INT4模型时的CPU/GPU协同调度效率比x86架构高40-60%，主要得益于统一内存架构消除PCIe带宽瓶颈，但无法弥补与V100集群在并行计算能力上的差距

sources.snippet: MLX and llama.cpp both run quantized LLMs on Apple Silicon unified memory. Here is what each project documents, and how to measure which wins on your Mac.
